findings.finding: the platform’s logical export carries no privileges
findings.detail: 0 privilege entries among the archive’s 938. Restored as it is: 168 of the 192 privilege lines of a freshly migrated database are not what the copy has; the service’s runtime role is refused (permission denied for schema app); 21 security-definer functions can be run by any role (5 in a migrated database).
findings.consequence: a service started on a copy restored from an export, with nothing more done, answers "degraded": it cannot read its own schema
findings.remedy: the privileges are put back from a freshly migrated reference database at the same migration level, then compared with it (this step)

findings.detail: no migration creates it and an owner who is not a superuser cannot
